title: Suicide Squad #28-33 Lot of 6 DC Rebirth 2017-2018 Harley Quinn Rob Williams
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Suicide Squad (DC Comics, 2016 DC Universe Rebirth series) - 6 consecutive issues. $2.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #28 - "The Secret History of Task Force X", Tony S. Daniel cover
- #29 - "The Secret History of Task Force X", Harley Quinn Tony S. Daniel cover
- #30 - "200,000 Miles from Earth... and It's Dinner Time!"
- #31 - Harley Quinn skeleton astronaut cover
- #32 - "The Return of Rick Flag... the End of Task Force X!"
- #33 - "The Chosen One" Part One, Si Spurrier begins

Written by Rob Williams (#28-32) and Si Spurrier (#33).

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
